import Mathlib

open Polynomial
/--
Prove that a splitting field of \( X^{15} - 2 \) over \( \mathbb{F}_7 \) is generated by a
 primitive \( 45 \)-th root of unity.
-/
theorem exists_isPrimitiveRoot_and_adjoin_eq_top :
    letI : Fact (Nat.Prime 7) := by decide
    ∃ ζ : (X ^ 15 - 2 : (ZMod 7)[X]).SplittingField, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ 45 ∧
    IntermediateField.adjoin (ZMod 7) {ζ} = ⊤ := by
  sorry

cd /work; cat > scratch/main.lean <<'EOF'
import Mathlib

open Polynomial
/--
Prove that a splitting field of \( X^{15} - 2 \) over \( \mathbb{F}_7 \) is generated by a
 primitive \( 45 \)-th root of unity.
-/
theorem exists_isPrimitiveRoot_and_adjoin_eq_top :
    letI : Fact (Nat.Prime 7) := by decide
    ∃ ζ : (X ^ 15 - 2 : (ZMod 7)[X]).SplittingField, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ 45 ∧
    IntermediateField.adjoin (ZMod 7) {ζ} = ⊤ := by
  intro hp
  classical
  set f : (ZMod 7)[X] := X ^ 15 - 2 with hf
  set K := f.SplittingField with hK
  have hsep : f.Separable := by
    have h := separable_X_pow_sub_C (F := ZMod 7) (n := 15) (2 : ZMod 7) (by decide) (by decide)
    rw [hf, map_ofNat C 2]
    exact h
  have hdeg : f.natDegree = 15 := by
    rw [hf, map_ofNat C 2]
    exact natDegree_X_pow_sub_C
  have hcard : Fintype.card (f.rootSet K) = 15 := by
    rw [card_rootSet_eq_natDegree hsep (SplittingField.splits f), hdeg]
  have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg natDegree h
    rw [hdeg] at this
    simp at this
  have hroot : ∀ x ∈ f.rootSet K, x ^ 15 = 2 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [mem_rootSet_of_ne hf0] at hx
    simpa [hf, sub_eq_zero] using hx
  obtain ⟨⟨x0, hx0⟩⟩ : Nonempty (f.rootSet K) :=
    Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (by rw [hcard]; norm_num)
  have hx0p : x0 ^ 15 = 2 := hroot x0 hx0
  have hx0ne : x0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hx0p
    have : (2 : K) = 0 := by rw [← hx0p]; simp
    exact absurd this (by
      intro h2
      have := congrArg (fun y : K => (y : K)) h2
      sorry)
  sorry
EOF
